items.description:
Eagle Elevators (Pty) Ltd supplies and installs platform and passenger lifts, with customer service that begins at first contact and continues through its experienced installation crew. The company treats a lift as an investment in a building, since it improves accessibility and property value, and its team guides clients through choosing the right lift for their needs.

Its installation and commissioning process runs through a full site survey with site-specific drawings and a risk assessment, pre-shipping inspection and delivery, installation to the project timeline, commissioning and staff training, and ongoing service, maintenance and emergency support. The company also offers manuals and technical support for its RICO specialty lifts. Based in Amandasig, Akasia, Eagle Elevators suits property owners and developers who need a lift supplied, installed and maintained by one specialist team.

Earth Gleam is a waste management and recycling company that works with households and organisations to divert recyclable material away from landfill. Its approach starts with source separation at the point of waste generation, supported by colour-coded indoor waste-separation bins that sort material into categories such as plastic, paper, glass and metal before it ever leaves a site.

From there, the company handles collection and transportation, using recycling cages to move sorted material efficiently between its clients and its recovery operations. This operational site at Eco Park in Centurion gives the business a base from which to serve homes and businesses across the area, forming part of a wider recycling and materials-recovery operation that treats correctly separated waste as a resource rather than rubbish.

Eastlynne Gamazine Factory Shop is a wall-coatings manufacturer and distributor based in Eastlynne, Pretoria, with 25 years of experience in the trade. It specialises in Gamazine paint, granite coating, Glamour Coat paint and various textured paints, made available in a wide range of colours for walls and ceilings.

The shop distributes its paint in both small and larger quantities to Pretoria, Soshanguve, Atteridgeville, Pretoria North, Centurion, Midrand and other areas. Customers can contact the shop directly for colour options and supply. It suits homeowners, painters and contractors in the greater Pretoria area who want Gamazine paint and related coatings sourced directly from the manufacturer.

Easy Build is part of the Easybuild group, a hardware retailer established in 1984 in Louis Trichardt that began by selling furniture, timber and hardware before growing into a specialised hardware retailer. The group expanded from small temporary structures into standalone stores and extended its operations from Limpopo into Gauteng, including this Laudium store, while branching into plumbing, tiles and sanitary ware through its EasyTile division.

Its range covers building materials, aluminium windows and doors, boards and shelving, cement, concrete products, galvanised fittings, ironmongery, steel doors and frames, timber and fencing. The group has been in operation for more than 30 years, which it says has built a trusted and reputable brand. It aims to be the preferred hardware retailer in the areas where it operates, and it suits builders and homeowners who want a long-established supplier for materials and hardware.

Easylife Kitchens Centurion designs and manufactures kitchens, bars, bathroom vanities, built-in cupboards, living space units and studies from its Hennopspark showroom. Customers can view the range of cabinetry types on its site, from kitchen islands to built-in cupboards, and the showroom team is available to meet and discuss a project in person.

The business publishes current promotions on its website and introduces its design team on a dedicated page. It operates from Unit 4, Lenchen Park, on the Old Johannesburg Road in Hennopspark. The showroom suits homeowners in Centurion and surrounding areas who want a custom-built kitchen or fitted cupboard designed and installed by a local manufacturer.

Eco Elementum (Eco-E) is a multidisciplinary consulting firm that has delivered more than a decade of environmental and legal compliance consulting since 2013. Its team includes professional engineers, construction managers, geologists, geohydrologists, technicians, environmental scientists, environmental assessment practitioners and legal auditors, who work across environmental, engineering, construction, and mining and geological services.

The firm says its focus is high quality, interdisciplinary and innovative consulting, design and construction solutions, with client relations placed at the heart of the business. Its services also include an Eco Intelligence offering. The firm's office hours are Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:30. Based in De Wilgers, Pretoria East, Eco Elementum suits clients across industries who need environmental, engineering and compliance work handled by one multidisciplinary team.

Electrahertz is a South African diversified electrical supply company that has traded since 1982, bringing electrical products and solutions sourced nationally and internationally to the local market. Its offering spans electrical supplies, including motor control and drives, power distribution and protection, automation, metering, energy efficiency and enclosure and climate controls, as well as plugs, sockets, timers and control relays.

The company also manufactures standard and purpose-built motor control panels and distribution boards as an independent supplier not tied to a single product line, and it offers guidance on renewable energy for domestic and commercial requirements. Its Bright Star Lighting Showroom lets customers view lighting products in person. Based in Salieshoek, Pretoria, the company suits electrical contractors and businesses that need supply, panel manufacturing and solar guidance from one wholesaler.

Electrothread is a privately owned manufacturer of electrical wiring interconnect systems, harnesses and cable assemblies, established in 2000 and based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, about 40 minutes from Johannesburg International Airport. The company received its first export contract in 2004 to supply wiring harnesses to a UK customer, and it has grown into a recognised international manufacturer serving customers in South Africa and abroad.

Electrothread achieved EN9100 certification in 2012, and it says it is the only company in South Africa supplying electrical interconnection products certified to this aerospace quality standard, among fewer than 20 companies nationally that hold it at all. Its shared values include quality, customer commitment, integrity and teamwork. The company suits aerospace, defence, rail, motorsport and mass transport customers that need certified wiring systems.

Emenem Industrial is an industrial automation service provider founded in 2003, offering turnkey solutions and integrating diverse systems for manufacturing clients. Its services include hydraulic press automation, robotic integration, custom machine building, full system integration, electrical and heavy-current panel design and building, vision systems and piping installations.

The company says it has more than 20 years in industrial automation and a combined team experience of over 50 years, with an ethos built on character, trust and credibility. It works with brands including SICK, Siemens, Festo and SEW Eurodrive, and it invests in staff training and new technologies to meet international standards. Based in Klerksoord, Rosslyn, Pretoria, the company suits manufacturers that need automated systems engineered and supported by a single turnkey partner.

items.description:
Eris Property Group is an integrated property platform spanning development, asset management and operations across South Africa. Its property development arm delivers ground-up projects across commercial, industrial, retail and living sectors, managing each stage from site acquisition through planning and construction management to practical completion, with a single accountable development partner for each client.

The group's other services include property management, asset management, investment and fund management, property valuations, student accommodation and specialist retail services. It reports having developed properties worth more than R54 billion since 1997. The company's core capabilities include proven delivery on time and within budget, and structuring win-win solutions that align stakeholders. Its Menlyn office suits property owners, investors and developers across South Africa and sub-Saharan Africa who want development, management and valuation under one group.

ESE Manufacturing designs, manufactures and installs a wide range of storage and materials-handling products, including pallet racking, drive-in racking, pallet-flow racking, cantilever racking, high-bay racking and mini racking. Its range extends to shelving, gondolas, mobile shelving, steel cabinets, lockers, work benches, supermarket trolleys, counters and rack-supported mezzanine floors, manufactured in South Africa rather than imported.

Family-owned and trading since 1998, the company draws on a team with more than 100 years of combined experience in storage and materials-handling equipment. It serves trade and retail businesses, warehouses and industrial operations that need shelving and racking designed, built and installed to suit their site. Based in East Lynne, Pretoria, ESE Manufacturing suits businesses looking for a long-established, locally manufacturing supplier of storage systems.

Esquire Technologies is a Southern African technology and digital-lifestyle distributor, supplying products from international vendors across IT hardware, computer components, displays, storage and networking equipment. Its range also covers CCTV and security products, consumer electronics, and mobility products and accessories, bringing a broad catalogue of technology brands into the local market under one distributor.

The company describes itself as an award-winning Southern African technology business, and it serves resellers, businesses and consumers who need current technology and mobility products sourced reliably. Alongside its Centurion base in Samrand, it operates further offices in Durban and Cape Town, giving it reach across several of the country's major centres. Based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, Esquire Technologies suits resellers and consumers wanting a single distributor for IT and consumer-electronics products.

Evolving Marketing Solutions is a digital marketing agency in Pretoria that builds systems combining website design, SEO, Google Ads, social media management and CRM automation into one strategy rather than a template package. The agency says it was built to help South African businesses stop guessing about their marketing and start growing, addressing problems such as a website that is not converting or ads that are not delivering leads.

Its services also include hosting, graphic design, corporate identity and branding, photography and visual content, smart business cards and blog writing. The agency works with businesses in Pretoria, Johannesburg and across Gauteng, aiming to tie every service to one strategy focused on the client's bottom line. Based in Wingate Park, Pretoria, it suits SMEs that want their digital marketing unified under one plan rather than run as separate pieces.

Falke Hosiery is a Rosslyn manufacturing plant producing hosiery and technical socks for running, skiing and hiking. The factory produces the Mikado hosiery and sock brand for the local South African market, while also manufacturing Falke-branded technical socks that are mostly exported to the brand's German parent company, with more than 80 per cent of that Falke-branded production reported as going abroad.

As of 2024, the factory employed 164 staff, reflecting a manufacturing operation of meaningful scale within Rosslyn, Akasia. Its factory shop is open to the public on Wednesdays and Fridays, giving local customers direct access to its sock and hosiery ranges. Based on Hendrik Van Der Bijl Street, Rosslyn, the plant suits both export markets and local shoppers seeking technical and everyday hosiery.

FAW Trucks Pretoria West is the Pretoria West dealership for FAW, the commercial vehicle division of one of the world's largest truck manufacturers. Its range covers freight carriers, truck tractors, tippers, mixers and compactors, and customers can select a truck category and then the capacity that fits their operation.

The dealership backs its sales with finance, genuine FAW parts, qualified technicians and driver training, and it promises direct contact with sales, parts and finance staff rather than a call centre. Its after-sales support covers servicing, parts and warranties, with the aim of minimising downtime for commercial operators. The dealership is on Malie Street in Zandfontein, Pretoria West, and it suits freight and logistics operators that need trucks, finance and service support from one local dealer.

FLEETMAX AFRICA, through its subsidiary Drive4Life, is a transport consultancy specialising in fleet risk management and professional driver training. Its team draws on experience in transport, traffic, road safety and law enforcement to provide affordable, customised transport skills and safety solutions for fleets of any size.

Its courses cover security, law enforcement, emergency services and first responder training, first aid, incident management and roadside firefighting. The company is a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor, and its learning material is approved by TETA, LGSETA, ETDP and SASSETA, and it is listed on the National Treasury database. Based in Laudium, Pretoria, the consultancy suits fleet operators and transport companies that want safer drivers and smarter fleet management through structured training.

Foam Factory is a foam manufacturer and converter supplying foam blocks, sheets, cut sizes and profile cuts, with precision CNC foam cutting to almost any size and shape. Its open-cell, flexible polyurethane foam range includes standard virgin foam, rebonded foam, memory foam and high-resilience foam, serving furniture, upholstery, packaging, automotive, medical and industrial customers.

The company also manufactures custom mattresses for caravans, campers, bakkies and boats, plus medical support products and mattress toppers, and customers can buy directly from its factory shops without a middleman. Its sister brand, Driftaway Beds and Pillows, is designed and manufactured in-house. Foam Factory has branches in Centurion, Cape Town and East London, and the Sunderland Ridge site suits trade and individual buyers who need foam cut and supplied to a precise specification.

Fourier-E is a business-engineering consultancy that aims to establish resilient operations for clients facing volatility, uncertainty and complexity, with a focus on decision support, supply chain engineering and business process engineering. Its decision support service helps businesses evaluate and quantify improvement opportunities, while its supply chain and business process work aims to reduce costs and increase value for customers and shareholders.

The firm partners with businesses in healthcare, cash management, manufacturing and mining, addressing questions such as end-to-end visibility of a manufacturing or cash supply chain, and whether a mining site's layout hides wasted cycle time. It works with tools including QPR Software to support its consulting. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, Fourier-E suits organisations that want their operations and supply chains re-engineered for measurable value.

Fusion, trading as Fusion Corporate Secretarial Services, is an outsourced company secretarial provider that ensures a company is compliant with its Memorandum of Incorporation, the Companies Act and the King Code of corporate governance. Its services include accepting the formal appointment of company secretary, maintaining statutory secretarial records, and preparing and lodging returns with the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission.

The firm also attends board and board committee meetings and strategy sessions, prepares agendas and board packs, writes up minutes, and assists with shareholder meetings, including preparing the chairman's agenda and compiling minutes afterwards. It draws up board resolutions and prepares an annual board timetable of meetings. Based in Centurion Central, Fusion suits JSE-listed and private companies that need a dedicated company secretary and governance support.

G3G is an SAP partner with a track record of helping clients maximise their SAP investments, offering ERP advisory services, SAP support and VAR maintenance, and ERP licensing. Its SAP Business One service helps growing small and medium businesses build an ERP foundation, while its SAP Cloud ERP and S/4HANA transformation services support larger digital transformation projects, including moving from SAP ECC to S/4HANA.

The company describes itself as going beyond implementation, covering fully managed hosted services, end-user support, training and business process enhancement, while working to reduce the costs associated with SAP support. Its products include SAP Business Process Automation, SAP Customer Checkout and SAP Analytics Cloud. Based in Alphen Park, Pretoria, G3G suits growing and established businesses that need SAP systems implemented, supported and kept cost-effective.

Gers Plastics and Rubber Machinery (GPRM) is a well-established supplier of imported machinery for the plastics and rubber industries in Southern Africa, founded in 1996 and based in Pretoria. Its range covers plastics extrusion, recycling, compounding, pelletising, milling and testing equipment, along with rubber compression and extrusion machinery, sourced from leading global brands including EXTRUDEX of Germany.

The company's extrusion equipment is built to minimise material costs, which can account for up to 80 per cent of operating costs, through low energy consumption and precision feeding that reduces sagging. Its large granulators use quick-change blades that cut blade-replacement time from around four hours to 20 minutes, boosting uptime. The company serves clients from educational institutions to multinational corporates, and its Villieria base suits manufacturers that need processing machinery, spare parts and electrical support from an established supplier.

Get Visible builds affordable websites for South African small businesses, noting that 72 per cent of small businesses in the country have no website at all. Its websites start from R5,000, and a free demo is built within 48 hours so customers can see a real version of their site before paying anything.

Once a client approves the demo, the full site goes live within about a week, with options including a three-page or five-page build, mobile-responsive design, a WhatsApp contact button, Google Maps integration, SEO setup, a photo gallery or portfolio, and a Google Business listing. The company compares a business with no website to one with a working site and says it handles the whole process from first contact to launch. Based in Woodhill Golf Estate, Pretoria, it suits small businesses that want an affordable website built quickly without technical hassle.

Glass Partners North is the Hennopspark branch of one of Africa's largest independent glass companies, offering a product range that includes the Thermo-Safe-GP safety glass range, the Thermo-Sun-GP range and Thermo-Sig-GP double-glazed units, along with specialised glass products. The company publishes a glass dictionary on its website to help customers understand the terminology used in the industry.

Its services include glass cutting, polishing, drilling and bevelling, assembly of double-glazed units, and SABS-approved toughened and laminated safety glass, drawing on MaxCut technology referenced on its site. Established in 2010, the branch is based in Hennopspark, Centurion, and it suits builders, glaziers and homeowners who need safety glass products cut and finished to specification.

Global Apostille Service is a document authentication and legalisation agency registered with the Department of International Relations and Cooperation, assisting individuals and companies in Pretoria, Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban with Hague apostille and embassy legalisation for documents used abroad. It apostilles a wide range of documents, including birth, death, marriage and educational certificates, letters of non-impediment, passport copies, police clearance certificates, powers of attorney, court documents and driving licence confirmation letters.

Its core services include DIRCO apostille processing, High Court apostille services, police clearance certificate applications and letter of non-impediment applications. The agency says its quick process saves clients time, since they simply send their information and the team handles the rest, backed by a reliable team of document legalisation experts. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, the agency suits individuals and businesses who need South African documents certified for use overseas.

Globe Tech Resource Solutions (GTRS) is a specialist recruitment business focusing on the mining and processing sector, supplying companies with top-calibre candidates both nationally and internationally. Its large database of specialised professionals lets it source candidates for any location, and its consultants familiarise themselves with each client's operations, sometimes visiting sites, to understand both operational needs and the working environment.

GTRS offers full-time, contract and fixed-term recruitment, as well as headhunting, which lets corporate clients recruit from competitors without approaching them directly. The company charges a once-off flat rate fee for successfully placed candidates, or clients can use GTRS on a retainer basis, which it says can save up to half of a yearly recruitment budget. Based in Clubview, Centurion, GTRS suits mining and processing companies that need specialist recruitment with a borderless, Southern African reach.

Groenbou Konstruksie is a Pretoria building contractor established in 2003 by master electrician Renier Groenewald, who brings more than two decades of experience to the company. Renier's journey began in 2004 with the construction of the company's first residential home in Montana, Pretoria, and within a year Groenbou Konstruksie received the NHBRC Highly Commended Best Home Builder of the Year award in 2005.

The company offers a full spectrum of services, from residential and commercial construction to renovations and sustainable solar installations. It describes its team as professional, dedicated and run like a family, committed to skill, precision and client satisfaction on every project. Based in Kameeldrift, Pretoria, the company suits homeowners and developers who want an award-recognised builder for new construction, renovations or solar work.

Guard4Sure Security Services (Pty) Ltd is an integrated security and facility-management company offering manned guarding, electronic security and video alarm systems alongside specialised equipment such as X-ray machines and metal detectors. Its facility-management offering is centralised, giving corporate and government clients a single point of coordination for security and site-management needs.

Established in 2007, the company has grown from a small manned-guarding operation into a broader integrated security and facility-management business serving corporate organisations and government departments across Gauteng and the surrounding areas. Based in Riviera, Pretoria, Guard4Sure suits organisations that want guarding, electronic security and facility management handled by one established provider rather than several separate contractors.

HBE Consulting is a technical, quality and project-management practice offering ISO 9001:2015 certification support, quality management and configuration management services. Its work extends into project management, nuclear-industry support, supplier development and SMME business-support services, covering both the technical and administrative sides of running compliant projects.

Operating since January 2011, the practice works with businesses and project organisations that need quality systems, project oversight, supplier development or technical business support handled by specialists rather than managed in-house. Based in Rietvalleirand, Pretoria, HBE Consulting suits companies pursuing ISO certification, managing complex projects, or building supplier and small-business capacity as part of their operations.

HENSOLDT Optronics is the Optronics business unit of HENSOLDT South Africa, specialising in electro-optical and optronic technologies for defence and security applications. The wider HENSOLDT South Africa business also covers radar, electromagnetic warfare, identification friend-or-foe and datalink systems, placing the Centurion optronics work within a group that spans several sensor and mission-critical technology fields.

South Africa is described as HENSOLDT's largest industrial base outside Germany, built on more than 60 years of heritage in the country. The business serves defence and security customers alongside civil-market customers who need sensor and mission-critical technology. Based on Nellmapius Drive in Highveld, Centurion, HENSOLDT Optronics suits government, defence and civil clients needing specialised optronic and sensor systems support.

Iritron is a Level 1 B-BBEE empowered engineering, integration and manufacturing company that provides solutions in electrical, instrumentation, control systems and decision support systems. Its electrical and instrumentation engineering covers the design, operation, simulation and automation of generation, transmission and distribution systems, while its control and expert systems work includes DCS, PLC and SCADA systems, advanced process control, process simulation and digitisation.

Its decision support systems cover manufacturing execution systems, manufacturing operations management, enterprise manufacturing intelligence, finite capacity scheduling and AI machine learning integration. The company also manufactures custom panels and motor control centres to international standards and provides construction installation management, plant automation audits and service level agreements to keep plants running optimally. Based in Persequor Technopark, Brummeria, Iritron suits industrial clients that need engineering, control systems and manufacturing support from one empowered partner.

Irrigation - Pretoria, trading as Just Green Irrigation, designs irrigation and landscaping solutions around each site's specific conditions rather than offering a single standard package. Its systems are planned around plant growth needs, available water sources and the contours of the ground, so that each irrigation setup suits the property it is built for.

The business has provided irrigation and landscaping services in the Pretoria area for more than 22 years, using trained staff to design and install systems for residential and industrial customers, and it also serves clients in the Johannesburg area. Based in La Montagne, Pretoria, Just Green Irrigation suits homeowners and industrial clients who want an irrigation and landscaping solution designed around their own garden or site rather than a one-size-fits-all layout.

ITR Technology is an IT company offering ManageEngine solutions covering IT management for managed service providers, enterprise service management, security information and event management, identity and access management, unified endpoint management and IT operations management. Its enterprise service management product combines an IT help desk with integrated asset and project management built on an ITIL framework.

Its security information and event management solutions aim to prevent malicious threats and security breaches while supporting compliance and auditing of user activity, and its identity and access management tools centre on Active Directory management for Windows environments. Unified endpoint management lets IT teams manage, patch and secure servers, desktops, laptops and mobile devices from one location. Based in Blue Valley Golf Estate, Centurion, the company suits IT teams and managed service providers that need ManageEngine tools for hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

Jacques Terry Orthotic and Prosthetic Services is a unique orthopaedic practice founded in 2007, specialising in custom-made orthopaedic braces as well as off-the-shelf orthopaedic soft good products for various applications. The practice provides professional orthotic and prosthetic services to the greater Gauteng area and surrounding provinces, through individual consultation, tele-consultation and custom-made devices suited to each client's needs, alongside pre-made products for a variety of lifestyles.

Its team includes an orthotist and prosthetist, a wound care nurse and a registered nurse, with the nurse trained in measuring and fitting products including specialist and mastectomy breast garments. The practice also offers claim assist, helping clients process insurance claims with administrative, rehabilitation and follow-up support. Located on 5th Avenue in Les Marais, Pretoria, the practice suits patients who need custom orthotic or prosthetic devices and support through their claims process.

Jarvis Jacobs Raubenheimer Inc Attorneys (JJR Inc) is a law firm that says it is passionate about law and about people, prioritising clients' interests through a philosophy focused on delivering tangible value, fostering growth and enhancing innovation in their businesses. The firm's services include antenuptial contracts, BEE advisory services, and corporate and commercial, environmental and family law matters.

The firm has regional offices in Pretoria, Gauteng, and Nelspruit, Mpumalanga, and clients can reach it by email or WhatsApp through its help centre. Its website publishes its story, its people and the latest news from the practice. Based in Weavind Park, Pretoria, the firm suits individuals and businesses that need corporate, commercial or family legal advice delivered with a long-term, relationship-focused approach.

Kaalvoet Studio is a specialised design business built around design and décor products together with laser cutting, classified under specialised design activities. Its laser-cutting work covers materials such as wood and perspex, paired with a range of décor products, giving the studio both a design and a production side under one roof.

Customers come to Kaalvoet Studio for custom design, décor products and laser-cutting work handled together rather than sourced from separate suppliers. The studio operates on weekdays and is based on Ketting Street in Wingate Park, Pretoria, making it a practical choice for customers in the area who want custom décor or laser-cut pieces designed and produced locally.

Khulandle Consulting Engineers SA is an independent design practice providing professional consulting services in mechanical and electrical engineering, information communication technology and project management, from conceptualisation through to commissioning. The company is a Black Economic Empowerment South African consulting firm, previously trading as MA Dlamini and Hlanze Consulting Engineers, with dedicated professional and administrative staff.

The firm has worked since 2007 and reports 200 completed projects, 189 satisfied clients and 100 partnerships, serving clients ranging from government to private sector. Its mission is to provide professional engineering services that efficiently meet clients' technical requirements, with a continual focus on sustainable design. Based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, the firm suits government and private clients who need multidisciplinary engineering consulting from an established BEE practice.

Labretoria has supported Southern Africa's scientific community since 1973, supplying dependable lab equipment, consumables and expert service across research, education, diagnostics, agriculture and industry. Its offering includes general and specialised laboratory equipment, chemicals, reagents and consumables, tools for plant tissue culture and agro-diagnostics, and storage, safety and lab support solutions, along with custom sourcing and import assistance.

The company partners with respected global brands such as Duchefa Biochemie, Bioreba, PhytoTech Labs, Hanna Instruments and Adam Equipment to ensure quality and consistency, and it offers service in both English and Afrikaans. Labretoria is registered on the Central Supplier Database, which allows seamless procurement for universities, government departments and other public institutions. Based in Murrayfield, Pretoria, the business suits laboratories, researchers and agricultural scientists who need reliable equipment and reagents from a long-established local supplier.

LDV Attorneys Inc is a law firm established in 2011 that specialises in labour law, representing clients in Gauteng with a philosophy of being big enough to matter and small enough to care. The firm is committed to placing clients' interests first, providing a quality, fast, accurate and personalised service, and differentiates itself through professional, tailor-made solutions rather than standard packages.

The firm offers a free consultation to prospective clients and publishes a company profile and latest news on its website. Based in Val de Grace, Pretoria, LDV Attorneys suits businesses and individuals in Gauteng who need specialist labour law representation handled with close personal attention.

Leano Marketing and Online Business Management is a women-owned firm in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, offering social media management, SEO optimisation and digital strategy with flexible on-site and online appointment scheduling. The firm tailors its solutions for start-ups and established businesses, aiming for clear, measurable results in a professional, client-focused atmosphere.

Its premises offer gender-neutral toilets, wheelchair-accessible parking, seating and a wheelchair-accessible toilet, alongside on-site and online appointment options. The firm describes its service as ranging from small businesses to larger corporations. Based on Strandloper Avenue in Rooihuiskraal, it suits businesses in Centurion that want flexible, accessible marketing support with a personal touch.

LearnMe Learnerships is a human capital solutions consultancy offering B-BBEE alignment, learnerships, skills programmes, HR solutions, payroll solutions and employment equity plans, helping businesses fund, train and educate their workforce. Its services include SETA learnerships for people with disabilities, employed and unemployed learnerships, skills programmes, workplace skills plan and WSP/ATR submissions.

The company's outsourced HR and payroll services are designed to take administrative work off clients' hands, and its accreditations span several SETAs, including Agri SETA, Construction SETA, Services SETA and TETA. Its mission is to provide high-quality training in the shortest possible time at the most cost-effective rate, while adding value through the experience of its management team. Based in Centurion Central, LearnMe suits employers across South Africa that need B-BBEE compliance and skills development handled together.

LEDworx Solutions works as an LED lighting consultant, wholesaler and manufacturer, covering the full chain from advice through to supply of LED lighting products. Customers dealing with the company receive guidance on LED lighting choices alongside the lights themselves, rather than being left to choose fittings without input from someone who understands the technology.

Its combined role as manufacturer and wholesaler means LEDworx Solutions can supply LED lights at scale while still consulting directly with individual customers on what suits a particular space or application. Based at The Yard on Lynnwood Road in Equestria, Pretoria, the company suits homeowners, businesses and contractors who want LED lighting products sourced and advised on by a single specialist supplier rather than a general electrical retailer.

M TECH Training Consultants is a SETA-accredited training provider with industry knowledge spanning more than nine years, offering first aid, soft skills, health and safety, driver training, lifting equipment, and construction and earthmoving courses. The company is a Level 1 BEE contributor and is fully accredited with TETA, PSETA, MERSETA, CETA and HWSETA, delivering quality-assured short courses, skills programmes and full qualification certificates.

Its stated mission is to be one of the leading corporate training companies in South Africa, and its training solutions comply with SAQA standards. The company reports 13 years in business, more than 2,500 classes completed and over 330 happy clients. It trades Monday to Thursday from 8:00 to 16:45 and Friday from 8:00 to 15:30, closed on weekends. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, the provider suits employers that need accredited safety, first aid and skills training for their staff.

Mabra Construction was established in 1988 and manages all its contracts from its head office in Tshwane East. Its directors, contract managers and senior site managers bring a combined 70 years of experience in general building operations, and the company has completed projects across Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga, the Free State and North West.

Its services cover offices, industrial buildings, retail, educational buildings, luxury housing, tenant installations and renovations, and the company complies with legal requirements including the Occupational Health and Safety Act. Past projects include alterations to Home Hyper City, a 200-bed alteration at TUT, and work for the Ethiopian Embassy. The company's mission is built on the idea that satisfied clients are its success, delivered through an experienced, hands-on management team. Based in Shere, Pretoria, Mabra suits developers and institutions that need an established contractor for commercial, educational or residential building work.

Maduwa Paint World provides professional painting, waterproofing and finishing for residential and commercial projects across South Africa, from RDP homes to rooftops and commercial sites. The company, founded by Rodney Maduwa, has painted more than 2,000 homes and holds a Nedbank Business Award, with more than 10 years of experience as a small business.

Customers can follow their project's progress through a secure online portal while the team coordinates work on site, with safety and coordination built into every job. The company's factory and head office is in Topaz Park, Rosslyn, Pretoria, and it also operates branches in Witbank, Malamulele, Makhado and Atteridgeville. It suits homeowners and commercial clients across South Africa who want a tracked, coordinated painting and waterproofing service from an award-winning small business.

Mamonyane Construction CC is a well-established black-owned enterprise that provides turnkey construction management and property development to private and public-sector clients, with more than 20 years of construction experience in South Africa. Over the past 24 years the company has grown in experience and capacity, surviving a challenging construction environment while aiming to become one of the leading black-owned construction companies in South Africa.

Its business units cover civil works, general building, maintenance, property development, renovations and turnkey construction, spanning new commercial, industrial and residential structures as well as restorations of heritage buildings. Its portfolio includes work for Anglo American Platinum Mines, Booysendal Mine walkway paving, the Kings Crossing and Queens Crossing developments, the New Rayton Development and Nkangala TVET College. Based in Pretoria Central, the company suits public and private clients that need an experienced, diversified construction partner for projects of varying scale.

This Markham store in Wonderpark Shopping Centre sells men's clothing, footwear and accessories, covering both casual and smart-wear ranges for everyday and more formal needs. Shoppers can choose in-store shopping, or use the brand's collection and delivery options when they would rather order ahead and have items delivered or ready to collect.

Based at Shop 129 in Wonderpark Shopping Centre, on the corner of Brits Road and Heinrich Avenue in Karenpark, Akasia, this Markham store suits men shopping for clothing, footwear and fashion accessories who want the choice of browsing in person or having their order delivered.
